result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but one section header displays a raw localization key instead of translated text. Other elements (carousels, promo banner, restaurant cards, bottom navigation) appear intact.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' shows the untranslated i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for 'home_feed.popular_title' to the locale files and ensure a fallback to the default language is used when a key is missing.
